UA_SPEND_UNIFIED_V2.comment: Versioned paid-UA spend mart for all titles, reconciled from AD_SPEND_DAILY and carrying source_meta for the versioned calculation.

PUSH_NOTIFICATION_STATS.comment: Daily push-notification send/open/click stats for shipped games, with nested delivery metadata.

PLAYER_DAILY_PROGRESS.comment: Per-player daily snapshot: level reached, sessions, coins, boosters, levels attempted/completed, purchase flag. coins_earned is what play paid out; coins bought from the store arrive as iap_grant rows in RESOURCE_FLOW_EVENTS and are not counted here. coins_spent and boosters_used count purchases at

Level ranges present: domino_delights 1-4755, zombie_match_3d 1-300. fail_reason_top is the modal failure for that level and uses each title's OWN fail vocabulary -- the two games do not share one. Aggregated upstream of the retained event tables. RAW_GAME_EVENTS an

USER_COHORT_RETENTION.comment: Weekly install cohorts with Day 1 through Day 60 retention, 242 cohort rows. D1 across cohorts ranges 0.0%-75.0%, unweighted mean 24.8% over all 242 cohorts. Per-cohort scatter is wide. Aggregated upstream of the retained event tables. RAW_GAME_EVENTS and STG_EVENTS_ENRICHED retain a 1:8 session sam

DIM_PLAYER.comment: Player dimension for the install universe, 28,609 rows. Acquisition channels are derived from INSTALL_EVENTS and match AD_SPEND_DAILY. Channel mix: adjoe 8,730, applovin 644, google_uac 256, meta 790, organic 14,068, unity_ads 4,121.

REVENUE_DAILY.comment: Daily revenue aggregated by game, platform, and top country. Includes both IAP and ad revenue. Best single day by game -- domino_delights peaks at $159.03 on 2025-06-28; zombie_match_3d peaks at $1.99 on 2025-07-31. Aggregated upstream of the retained event tables. RAW_GAME_EVENTS and STG_EVENTS_ENR

REVENUE_DAILY_V2.comment: Versioned all-title revenue mart. Keeps a calc_metadata payload explaining the scope. Aggregated upstream of the retained event tables. RAW_GAME_EVENTS and STG_EVENTS_ENRICHED retain a 1:8 session sample, and PROGRESSION_EVENTS, SESSION_LEVEL_EVENTS and AD_IMPRESSION_EVENTS a 1:16 sample, so a recou

DAILY_METRICS_AGG.comment: Daily metrics mart derived from the DAU and revenue tables. Aggregated upstream of the retained event tables. RAW_GAME_EVENTS and STG_EVENTS_ENRICHED retain a 1:8 session sample, and PROGRESSION_EVENTS, SESSION_LEVEL_EVENTS and AD_IMPRESSION_EVENTS a 1:16 sample, so a recount from those tables will

MONTHLY_BURN.comment: Monthly cash burn by expense category, 212 rows across 30 months (2023-04..2025-09). Peak monthly burn $158,557 (2024-09).

CASH_BALANCE.comment: Month-end cash position, 30 closed months 2023-04..2025-09 Key milestones: the seed round totals $3.00M across 8 entries, the largest a $2.70M wire from the lead investor; Jul 2025 month-end ($286K, 3.6 months runway).

HEADCOUNT.comment: Employee roster with monthly cost, 335 rows (one per employee per cost regime; employee_id is NOT unique). 3 founders and 18 non-founder staff over the company's life. Non-founder payees peaked at 16, reached in 2024-09 and 2025-04. That payee count is non-founder FULL-TIME plus non-founder CONTRACT

LIVE_EVENT_PERFORMANCE.comment: Per-event metrics for all live-ops events, 529 runs. Event catalogue present in this table: Axe Arena, Plague Race, River Rush, Season Pass, Streak Fever, Weekly Leaderboards, Weekly Quests, Win & Collect. Recorded incidents against these events -- 2024-11-15 Weekly Quests: Quest-system auto-deploy

RESOURCE_FLOW_EVENTS.comment: Sink/source ledger for the in-game economy, 1,308,560 rows: one row-set per PLAYER_DAILY_PROGRESS player-day. Not a sample. Currency movements present: bones source 7,002, coins sink 27,037, coins source 1,274,521. Booster prices as transacted: draw_3 1200, draw_5 1800, dynamite 1000, glue 400, gust

VIRTUAL_CURRENCY_LEDGER.comment: Virtual-currency ledger, a 1:1 projection of RESOURCE_FLOW_EVENTS keyed by ledger_meta.source_event_id, preserving the Apr 2025 coin-crisis economy version. Amounts and running balances are the source row's, not recomputed.

RAW_GAME_EVENTS.comment: Derived from RAW_EVENTS and retained at a 1:8 session sample; sampling is by session, so every event of a retained session is present. Unprocessed client analytics firehose across all HG4 titles (GameAnalytics-style). One row per emitted event with device/geo/custom_fields as nested payloads. app_ve

STG_EVENTS_ENRICHED.comment: Derived from RAW_EVENTS and retained at a 1:8 session sample; sampling is by session, so every event of a retained session is present. Enriched staging table over RAW_GAME_EVENTS with normalized country/device fields and event_attrs payload.

PROGRESSION_EVENTS.comment: Derived from RAW_EVENTS and retained at a 1:16 session sample; sampling is by session, so every event of a retained session is present. Raw level lifecycle stream for all titles. Includes nested board_state and custom_fields payloads.

STG_PROGRESSION_EVENTS.comment: Derived from RAW_EVENTS and retained at a 1:16 session sample; sampling is by session, so every event of a retained session is present. Thin staging layer over PROGRESSION_EVENTS with renamed join keys and retained board_state payload.

SESSION_LEVEL_EVENTS.comment: Derived from RAW_EVENTS and retained at a 1:16 session sample; sampling is by session, so every event of a retained session is present. Raw level attempt events (sampled). Each row = one player action: level_started, level_completed, level_failed, booster_used, or tutorial_step. LEVEL_PERFORMANCE is

CLIENT_ERROR_EVENTS.comment: Client crash/error log. Volume spikes on the known incident windows (Baklava launch crash, ZM3D launch crash + font freeze, progression wipe, etc.). ZM3D crashes concentrate at levels 3-5 (~82% per the crashed-users funnel). stack_context is a semi-structured OBJECT.

AD_IMPRESSION_EVENTS.comment: Derived from RAW_EVENTS and retained at a 1:16 session sample; sampling is by session, so every event of a retained session is present. One row per ad_impression event, priced at AD_REVENUE's daily eCPM for the same date, game, platform, country, network and placement; custom_fields.source_spend_dat

DESIGN_EVENTS.comment: Derived from RAW_EVENTS and retained at a 1:64 session sample; sampling is by session, so every event of a retained session is present. Reward and currency-grant design events projected from the RAW_EVENTS currency_grant stream: level, hourly, mini-game, live-ops, quest, chapter and IAP grants. A/B

DIM_DATE.comment: Calendar dimension over the active warehouse period.

DIM_COUNTRY.comment: Country dimension distinguishing revenue countries from UA-only countries.

DIM_DEVICE.comment: Device dimension: the phone/tablet models seen across HG4 titles with platform, OS version, form factor, and an estimated market value. Anchored to the device deep-dive device space (iPhone/iPad + Samsung/Pixel/Oppo/OnePlus). Domino Delights install sample skews ~77% iOS.

RAW_EVENTS.comment: Client telemetry, retained here at a deterministic 1-in-8 SESSION sample: 694,634 rows. Other tables in this schema are retained at different sample rates and some use a different session key name, so a session_id join against this table is not necessarily complete. Aggregate marts were computed bef

AD_SPEND.comment: What we paid the networks (as the MMP reported it).

AD_REVENUE.comment: What the networks paid us, split accrued vs paid.

STORE_TRANSACTIONS.comment: IAP receipts, 900 rows (2024-02-23 to 2025-09-29). GROSS: includes refunded receipts (is_refunded). ANALYTICS.MONETIZATION.IAP_TRANSACTIONS is this table NET of refunds and shares transaction_id, so it is a strict subset -- use this table for receipt counts and that one for revenue.

STORE_REVIEWS.comment: Player-submitted review text from the app stores.

PAYROLL_ROSTER.comment: The payroll roster that FINANCE_LEDGER salaries key off.
